hooks.name: inject-brain
hooks.command: python -c "import pathlib,runpy,sys; ds=(pathlib.Path.cwd(),*pathlib.Path.cwd().parents); d=next(d for d in ds if (d/'.gemini/hooks/scripts/inject-brain.py').is_file() or (d/'.git').exists()); p=d/'.gemini/hooks/scripts/inject-brain.py'; sys.argv=[str(p),'--provider','gemini']; runpy.run_path(str(p),run_name='__main__')"
